definitions.cos_current / cos_initial: cosine of the executed direction with the direction to the asset's CURRENT / INITIAL (obsolete) position at each decision
definitions.informative decisions: decisions where the two target directions differ by >= 3.0 deg as seen from the attacker (otherwise tracking is indistinguishable from aiming at the start point)
definitions.informative_fraction_current_better: fraction of informative decisions with cos_current > cos_initial; 1.0 = always aims toward the current rather than the obsolete location
